column1: aatrox|Aatrox|近战吸血战士，周期性的赐死剑气按目标最大生命追加伤害；大灭让他暂时升空。|A melee drain fighter whose recurring Deathbringer strike adds max-health damage. World Ender temporarily takes him into the air.
anivia|Anivia|远程飞行法师。首次被击败化为蛋，存活后满血重生；冰雪风暴持续伤害并减速。|A ranged flying mage. Her first defeat leaves an egg that revives her at full health if it survives. Glacial Storm deals lingering damage and slows.
anivia_egg|Anivia’s Egg|冰鸟首次被击败后留下的地面形态。孵化成功后满血复生，不再生成新的蛋。|The ground form left after Anivia’s first defeat. Surviving the hatch restores her to full health, without another rebirth.
apex_turret|H-28Q Apex Turret|地面防守炮台，炮弹造成小范围伤害，主动激光可以穿透敌人。|A defensive turret with small-area shells against ground targets and an active piercing laser.
ashe|Ashe|可对空的远程射手，以冰霜减速牵制敌人，扇形箭雨阻挡逼近的部队。|A ranged anti-air archer who controls enemies with frost slows and a fan of arrows.
aurelionsol|Aurelion Sol|飞行吐息单位，持续伤害锁定目标。击杀积累星辰，让星落升级为天瀑。|A flying dragon whose breath continuously damages his locked target. Kills charge Falling Star into The Skies Descend.
azir|Azir|远程召唤法师。近期被他命中的敌军死亡时转化为黄沙士兵，建筑则转化为太阳圆盘。|A ranged summoner. Recently struck enemies become Sand Soldiers on death; destroyed structures become Sun Discs.
belveth|Bel’Veth|只攻击建筑的大型空中单位，死亡时释放一群可攻击空地的虚空鱼。|A large flying siege unit that targets structures. On death, she releases Void Remora that attack ground and air targets.
corki|Corki|可对空的飞行炮手，导弹碰撞后爆炸，最后一枚导弹威力更强。|A flying anti-air gunner. His missiles explode on first contact, with an empowered final missile.
corrosion|Corrosion|持续伤害区域，同时威胁空地单位和建筑；敌人离开区域后停止受伤。|A persistent damage zone affecting ground units, air units and structures. Leaving the zone stops its damage.
darius|Darius|普攻叠加流血，叠满后进入血怒。断头台击杀可以获得免费追斩。|Basic attacks stack bleeding and trigger Noxian Might at full stacks. A guillotine kill grants a free follow-up execution.
explosive_cask|Explosive Cask|从己方水晶抛出酒桶，落地爆炸并向外击退敌军；建筑不会被击退。|A cask thrown from your Nexus explodes on arrival and knocks enemies outward. Structures cannot be displaced.
freeze|Freeze|冻结落点附近的敌方单位、建筑卡与防御塔，水晶免疫。|Freezes enemy units, deployed buildings and towers near the impact point. Nexuses are immune.
garen|Garen|专注建筑的前排战士。用高生命承受火力，以强化攻击或旋转切入战线。|A durable frontline fighter focused on structures. Choose an empowered strike or a spinning attack to pressure the front.
gnar|Gnar|远程小纳尔与近战大纳尔循环变形，普攻命中推动形态切换。|Cycles between ranged Mini Gnar and melee Mega Gnar. Basic-attack hits advance each transformation.
gwen|Gwen|近战剪刀手，普攻和剪切附带目标最大生命伤害。可选连续剪切或阻挡圈外敌人的圣霭。|A melee skirmisher whose attacks and snips add max-health damage. Choose repeated snips or mist that blocks outside enemies.
heal|Heal|恢复范围内友方普通单位的生命，对建筑、防御塔与水晶无效。|Restores allied non-structure units in an area. Buildings, towers and Nexuses cannot receive this healing.
heavy_minion_squad|Heavy Division|超级兵与炮车兵前后部署，以重装前排保护远程火力。|Deploys a Super Minion ahead of a Siege Minion, shielding ranged firepower with a heavy frontline.
imp|Mist Walker|墓碑及召唤技能生成的小型地面近战单位。|A small ground melee unit created by Tombstone and its summoning ability.
jax|Jax|近战范围战士，连续命中逐渐提高攻速，反击风暴能免疫普攻伤害。|An area melee fighter who gains attack speed through repeated hits. Counter Strike makes him immune to basic-attack damage.
jinx|Jinx|可切换火箭炮与机枪的后排射手。参与摧毁建筑后获得罪恶快感。|A backline marksman who switches between rockets and a minigun. Taking part in a structure takedown triggers Get Excited.
kassadin|Kassadin|浮空但仍属于地面单位，可以直接过河并穿过普通单位，仍受建筑阻挡。|A hovering ground fighter who crosses the river and passes through ordinary units, but remains blocked by structures.
kayle|Kayle|根据部署时的金币自动选择近战或远程形态。两种形态都能飞行、攻击空地目标。|Available gold selects her melee or ranged form on deployment. Both forms fly and attack ground and air targets.
kayle_ranged|Kayle · Ranged|远程飞行形态，普攻同时发射追踪光剑和独立的穿透焰浪。|A ranged flying form whose attacks launch both a homing light blade and an independent piercing flame wave.
kayn|Kayn|穿越地形的成长战士。对远程或近战敌军的普攻任务决定后续部署的进阶形态。|A terrain-crossing fighter. Basic-attack quests against ranged or melee enemies unlock a form for future deployments.
kayn_assassin|Shadow Assassin|凯隐的高速进阶形态，进入地形回复生命并短暂加速。|Kayn’s fast advanced form, healing and briefly accelerating when entering terrain.
kayn_slayer|Rhaast|凯隐的续航进阶形态，普攻与技能附带最大生命伤害，并通过命中回血。|Kayn’s sustain form. Attacks and ability hits add max-health damage and restore health.
lightning|Lightning|连续选择区域内尚未受击、当前生命最高的目标，造成伤害和短暂眩晕。|Repeatedly strikes the highest-current-health enemy in the area that this cast has not yet hit, dealing damage and a brief stun.
lulu|Lulu|周期召唤皮克斯的远程法师，可永久强化一名尚未被增益的友军。|A ranged mage who periodically summons Pix and can permanently empower an ally that has not already received Wild Growth.
malphite|Malphite|慢速前排坦克，部署时获得花岗岩护盾。护盾存在时减伤，破碎后不再生。|A slow frontline tank deployed with Granite Shield. It reduces incoming damage while intact and does not regenerate once broken.
malzahar|Malzahar|空中后排召唤法师，周期召唤虚灵。可选压制引导或额外召唤。|A flying backline mage who periodically summons Voidlings. Choose a disabling channel or an additional swarm.
masteryi|Master Yi|移动与攻击都很快的地面近战单位，适合迅速接近脆弱后排。|A fast-moving ground melee fighter with rapid attacks, suited to closing on fragile backline units.
melee_minion|Melee Minion|低费用地面近战兵，可为后排承受伤害，也会出现在自然兵线中。|A low-cost ground melee minion that protects the backline and also appears in lane waves.
melee_minion_squad|Melee Squad|方阵部署近战兵，主动技能强化本次部署中仍存活的成员。|Deploys melee minions in a square. Its active empowers the surviving members of this deployment.
minion_squad|Minion Squad|近战与远程兵组成混合编队，分别承担前排与持续输出。|A mixed formation of melee and ranged minions, combining frontline protection with sustained fire.

mirror|Mirror|复制上一张成功使用的非镜像卡，按实际部署形态支付基础费用。主动席的镜像可继承预选技能。|Copies the last successfully played non-Mirror card at the base cost of its deployed form. In an active seat, Mirror can inherit the preselected ability.
missfortune|Miss Fortune|可对空的双枪射手，对每个目标的首次攻击造成更高伤害。|An anti-air marksman whose first attack against each target deals increased damage.
nocturne|Nocturne|可攻击空地目标的飞行近战单位，可选抵挡敌方效果或强化下一次攻击。|A flying melee unit that attacks ground and air targets. Choose to block an enemy effect or empower the next attack.
olaf|Olaf|并排部署的双斧战士，主动技能同时强化本批仍存活的狂战士。|A pair of axe-wielding melee fighters. Their active empowers every surviving Olaf from this deployment.
olaf_single|Olaf · Single|编队成员的单只参考条目，不能独立加入卡组。|A reference entry for an individual formation member, unavailable as a separate deck card.
ornn|Ornn|只攻击建筑的慢速坦克，锻造飞锤永久强化友军普攻，冲锋撞障碍可触发眩晕。|A slow siege tank whose forged hammer permanently buffs allied basic attacks. Charging into an obstacle triggers a stun.
pantheon|Pantheon|可在河道外的全图合法地面部署，落地滑行造成伤害，普攻积攒红怒强化长枪。|Deploys on legal ground outside the river across the arena. His landing sweep deals damage; attacks build Mortal Will for his spear.
pix|Pix|成组部署的小型空中射手，近距离发射紫色光弹。|A group of tiny flying shooters that fire purple bolts at close range.
pix_single|Pix · Single|用于查看单只皮克斯的关联实体，不可独立选入卡组。|An individual Pix reference entity, unavailable as a separate deck card.
ranged_minion|Caster Minion|低费用后排兵种，可以攻击地面和空中目标。|A low-cost backline minion that attacks both ground and air targets.
ranged_minion_squad|Caster Squad|紧凑三角形部署远程兵，主动技能强化本批存活成员。|Deploys caster minions in a compact triangle. The active empowers surviving members of this group.
rift_herald|Rift Herald|只攻击建筑的重型推进单位。一生一次冲撞，撞击后释放虚空蠕虫并失去部分当前生命。|A heavy siege unit with a once-per-life charge. Impact releases Voidmites and costs a portion of its current health.
sand_soldier|Sand Soldier|黄沙长矛士兵，仅攻击地面，不继承沙漠皇帝的转化能力。|A spear-wielding ground soldier that does not inherit Azir’s conversion passive.
scuttle_crab|Rift Scuttler|不造成普攻伤害的支援坦克，在建筑前跳舞回血，死亡后留下友方治疗区。|A support tank without basic-attack damage. It dances and heals near structures, leaving an allied healing zone on death.
sett|Sett|交替双拳攻击的近战前排，第二拳伤害更高，蓄意轰拳将豪意转为爆发和护盾。|A frontline brawler with a stronger second punch. Haymaker turns Grit into burst damage and a shield.
shurima_guard|Shurima Guard|横排部署黄沙士兵。只有摧毁敌方两路防御塔后，才能部署到对方半场合法区域。|Deploys a line of Sand Soldiers. Enemy-side deployment requires both opposing lane towers to be destroyed.
siege_minion|Siege Minion|远程炮击兵种，攻击较慢，但能从后方持续施压。|A long-range artillery minion with slow attacks and sustained backline pressure.
siege_minion_squad|Siege Battery|三角形部署炮车兵，以多门远程火炮压制战线。|Deploys a triangle of Siege Minions to pressure the battlefield with multiple artillery units.
sion|Sion|高生命攻城坦克，首次致死后短暂不可选中，再满血复生为持续流失生命的狂暴形态。|A high-health siege tank. His first lethal hit starts an untargetable revival, then a full-health berserk form that steadily loses health.

stasis|Stasis|星光抵达后同时凝滞双方单位。凝滞时无法行动、被选取或受伤，但保留碰撞；水晶免疫。|Starlight places both sides in stasis on arrival. Affected units cannot act, be targeted or take damage, but retain collision. Nexuses are immune.
sun_disc|Sun Disc|可对空的防守建筑，也能建立在已毁防御塔的精确塔墟上，免除持续生命衰减。|An anti-air defensive building. Placing it precisely on a destroyed tower foundation removes its ongoing health decay.
super_minion|Super Minion|高生命、高伤害的重型近战兵，为一路推进提供坚实前排。|A heavy melee minion with high health and damage, providing a strong frontline for a lane push.
super_minion_squad|Assault Division|并排部署超级兵，以重型近战阵线推进。|Deploys Super Minions side by side to form a heavy melee frontline.
target_dummy|Target Dummy|可选的防守建筑，用生命吸引火力，不能普攻；与练习用木桩不同。|A selectable defensive building that absorbs fire but cannot attack. Distinct from the practice dummy.
teemo|Teemo|灵活的远程射手，可用技能吹箭使敌人的后续普攻失效。|A mobile ranged shooter whose ability dart makes subsequent enemy basic attacks deal no damage.
tombstone|Tombstone|有寿命的召唤建筑，周期生成雾行者，死亡时额外召唤。|A temporary summoning building that periodically creates Mist Walkers and releases more on death.
tristana|Tristana|可对空的远程炮手，急速射击让她短时间内倾泻火力。|An anti-air ranged gunner whose Rapid Fire delivers a short burst of faster attacks.
tryndamere|Tryndamere|普攻积攒怒气，满怒攻击暴击。无尽怒火可在短时间内拒绝死亡。|Basic attacks build Fury for a critical strike at full Fury. Undying Rage briefly prevents death.
twisted_fate|Twisted Fate|可对空的远程法师，能在河道外的全图合法地面部署。|An anti-air ranged mage who can deploy on legal ground outside the river across the arena.
twitch|Twitch|脱战后隐身的射手。攻击起手破隐，隐身不免疫范围伤害。|A marksman who becomes invisible after leaving combat. Starting an attack reveals him; invisibility does not prevent area damage.
void_gate|Zz’Rot Portal|有寿命的召唤建筑，持续生成虚空兽，也可主动摧毁以追加召唤。|A temporary building that repeatedly creates Voidspawn. It can be sacrificed to summon additional units.

void_scuttle_crab|Void Scuttler|高生命支援坦克，建筑前自疗，死亡留下治疗区；被击杀给对方金币，主动自尽免除赏金。|A high-health support tank that heals near structures and leaves a healing zone on death. Being killed awards enemy gold; self-sacrifice avoids that bounty.
void_spawn|Voidspawn|成对部署的攻城生物，接近目标后牺牲自身，跃向固定落点并爆炸伤害锁定建筑。|A pair of siege creatures that sacrifice themselves near a target, leap to a fixed point and explode against the locked structure.
void_spawn_single|Voidspawn · Single|虚空兽的单只召唤实体，保留牺牲攻城能力，不可独立加入卡组。|An individual summoned Voidspawn with the same sacrifice attack, unavailable as a separate deck card.

void_summoning|Void Summoning|在固定区域内持续召唤近战虚空鱼。强化后，区域内符合条件的真正死亡可转化为更多己方虚空鱼。|Repeatedly summons melee Void Remora in a fixed area. When enhanced, eligible actual deaths inside the zone create additional allied remora.
voidfish|Void Remora|虚空女皇与虚空召唤生成的小型飞行近战单位，可攻击空地目标。|A small flying melee unit created by Bel’Veth and Void Summoning, able to attack ground and air targets.
voidfish_ranged|Ranged Remora|三角编队的远程空军，可用虚空再生为本批成员提供限时死亡替换。|A triangle of ranged flying units. Void Regeneration gives the group a temporary replacement-on-death effect.
voidfish_ranged_army|Ranged Remora Army|更大的远程空军编队，六边形部署，共享本批成员的虚空再生。|A larger hexagonal ranged air formation, sharing Void Regeneration across its deployed members.
voidfish_ranged_single|Ranged Remora · Single|虚空再生生成的单只远程鱼，不继承再生或主动技能资格。|An individual ranged remora created by regeneration, without inherited regeneration or active-ability eligibility.
voidling|Voidling|虚空先知召唤的小型地面近战单位。|A small ground melee unit summoned by Malzahar.
voidmite|Voidmite|峡谷先锋撞击建筑后生成的小型攻城召唤物，仅攻击建筑。|A small summoned siege unit released by Rift Herald on structure impact. It targets structures only.
xin|Xin Zhao|近战战士，部署时以新月护卫伤害并击退周围敌人，连续攻击恢复生命。|A melee fighter whose deployment sweep damages and knocks back nearby enemies. Repeated attacks restore health.
yorick|Yorick|重铲命中造成小范围伤害，临终仪式强化下一击，并在命中时回复生命。|His shovel strikes deal small-area damage. Last Rites empowers the next hit and heals him on impact.
zap|Zap|小范围电击，可同时命中地面、空中和建筑目标，并附带短暂眩晕。|A small-area lightning strike that hits ground units, air units and structures, with a brief stun.

blitzcrank|Blitzcrank|近战机器人，近身优先，锁定2至4.5格内的敌方地面单位，瞄准1秒后拉到身前；不牵引建筑。|A melee robot that prioritizes nearby enemies. Locks onto a ground unit 2–4.5 tiles away, aims for 1 second, then pulls it close. Cannot pull structures.

ekko|Ekko|Z型驱动共振：对每个目标的第三次有效普攻造成2倍普攻伤害，并获得3秒80%移动速度。不同目标独立计数，每个目标只触发一次。|The third basic-attack hit against each target deals double damage and grants 80% movement speed for 3 seconds. Targets track hits separately and each can trigger this passive only once.

hecarim|Hecarim|旋斩攻击四周地面敌人。连续自主移动3.5格后加速，下一击可从2.5格内接触目标时踢击，随后沿原方向续冲；击退0.5秒并眩晕1.5秒；致盲时只突进，不造成伤害或控制；蓄势时受阻会重置；突进可穿障，踢击不被眩晕打断，冰冻、凝滞、禁锢和击退会打断；落地可立即普攻。|Sweeps surrounding ground enemies. After moving 3.5 tiles continuously, gains speed and can charge a target from 2.5 tiles away, then continue forward. The kick knocks back over 0.5 seconds and stuns for 1.5 seconds. Blind prevents damage and control. Obstruction resets preparation. The dash crosses obstacles; stun does not interrupt the kick, but freeze, stasis, root and knockback do. Can attack immediately after landing.

jayce|Jayce|杰斯以远程形态部署，每8秒切换锤炮形态；到时打断普攻换形，硬控结束后补换形。远程首击额外40伤害，近战首击对主目标额外造成8%最大生命值伤害，对塔与水晶改为60；战锤形态只攻击地面目标。|Deploys in ranged form and switches between cannon and hammer every 8 seconds, interrupting attacks or waiting for hard control to end. The first cannon hit adds 40 damage; the first hammer hit adds 8% of the primary target’s maximum health, or 60 against towers and Nexuses. Hammer form attacks ground targets only.

powder_keg|Powder Keg|无法攻击的防守建筑，20秒内自然衰减。死亡对半径140像素内地面敌人造成300伤害；本次爆炸击杀任意敌方目标时获得1金币。|A defensive building that cannot attack and loses health over its 20-second lifetime. On death, deals 300 damage to ground enemies within 140 units. If the explosion kills any enemy target, gain 1 gold.

samira|Samira|远程双枪射手；目标表面间距1.6格以内改用刀刃，伤害提高50%，攻击间隔由1.4秒变为1秒。被动悍勇本色：远程命中叠1层、近战叠2层，每层加5%移速，满5层改为加30%。命中刷新4秒持续时间；炼狱扳机消耗满层，期间不能叠层。|A ranged gunslinger who switches to blades within a 1.6-tile surface gap, gaining 50% damage and reducing her attack interval from 1.4 to 1 second. Ranged hits add 1 Style stack and melee hits add 2. Each stack grants 5% movement speed, replaced by 30% at 5 stacks. Hits refresh the 4-second duration. Inferno Trigger consumes full Style and prevents stacking during its cast.

tidal_wave|Tidal Wave|仅在己方半场释放。4格宽的浪潮向敌方推进11格，对碰到的敌方地面目标造成120伤害并向前击退1格，每个目标仅命中一次。建筑不被击退，防御塔和水晶承受30%伤害。|Cast only in your own half. A wave 4 tiles wide travels 11 tiles toward the enemy, dealing 120 damage and pushing ground enemies forward 1 tile, once per target. Structures cannot be pushed; towers and Nexuses take 30% damage.

final_spark|Final Spark|仅在己方半场释放。预警1秒后，向敌方发射1格宽、20格长的闪光，对直线内地面、空中与建筑目标造成一次300伤害，防御塔与水晶承受30%。光束不被前排阻挡；余光在起手后2.5秒结束，无持续伤害。|Cast only in your own half. After a 1-second warning, fire a beam 1 tile wide and 20 tiles long toward the enemy, dealing 300 damage once to ground, air and structure targets. Towers and Nexuses take 30% damage. The beam passes through targets; its afterglow ends 2.5 seconds after the wind-up begins and deals no further damage.

severing_bolt|Severing Bolt|0.5秒前奏、1秒预警后，对半径1.625格内地面、空中与建筑目标造成120伤害。仅命中一个敌军时伤害为2.5倍，硬控目标为2倍，同时满足取较高值。防御塔与水晶最终承受30%伤害。|After a 0.5-second wind-up and 1-second warning, deal 120 damage to ground, air and structure targets within 1.625 tiles. Damage is multiplied by 2.5 when only one enemy is hit, or by 2 against hard-controlled targets; use the higher multiplier when both apply. Towers and Nexuses take 30% of the final damage.

pool_of_reflection|Pool of Reflection|清泉持续3秒，为半径2.75格内友方非建筑单位每秒补充60护盾，不设上限。离开清泉或清泉结束后护盾保留1秒，重叠清泉不加快补充。|Create a pool for 3 seconds that grants allied non-structure units within 2.75 tiles 60 shield per second, with no cap. Shield remains for 1 second after leaving the pool or its expiration. Overlapping pools do not increase the rate.
